title: Lesser Banishing Ritual of the Pentagram
summary: The Golden Dawn's foundational banishing: the Qabalistic Cross, four pentagrams, the archangels at the quarters, and the closing Cross.
tradition: Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn
source: Golden Dawn instructional material, c. 1888 to 1900 (public domain).

qabalistic-cross.title: Ateh
qabalistic-cross.text: Touch your forehead. Light gathers into a sphere above your crown.
qabalistic-cross.describe: A sphere of white light forms just above your head.

qabalistic-cross.title: Malkuth
qabalistic-cross.text: Touch your breast. The light descends through you and deep into the earth.
qabalistic-cross.describe: A column of light runs down through your body into the ground, and a ring of light spreads across the floor.

qabalistic-cross.title: ve-Geburah
qabalistic-cross.text: Touch your right shoulder. A point of scarlet force ignites.
qabalistic-cross.describe: A red point of light glows at your right shoulder.

qabalistic-cross.title: ve-Gedulah
qabalistic-cross.text: Touch your left shoulder. A point of blue mercy answers, and a beam joins them.
qabalistic-cross.describe: A blue point of light glows at your left shoulder, and a beam connects both shoulders.

qabalistic-cross.title: le-Olam
qabalistic-cross.text: Clasp your hands at your heart. You stand at the center of a cross of light.
qabalistic-cross.describe: The horizontal beam extends outward and a warm glow gathers at your heart.

qabalistic-cross.title: Amen
qabalistic-cross.describe: Every point of the cross brightens together.

steps.title: Stand at the center
steps.text: You are inside the circle, facing East. Breathe slowly. The {moon} watches, in the hour of {hour}.
steps.say: Stand at the center of the circle, facing East. Breathe slowly.
steps.describe: You stand at the center of a faint circle of light inscribed with four Hebrew names.

steps.title: Yod Heh Vav Heh
steps.text: Face the East. Trace the banishing pentagram of Earth, beginning at your left hip. Stab its center and vibrate the name.
steps.describe: A blue flaming pentagram is drawn in the air to the East, and the name appears above it.

steps.title: Carry the line to the South
steps.text: Keep your arm extended. A line of white fire follows your hand around the circle.

steps.title: Adonai
steps.text: Trace the banishing pentagram of Earth in the South. Stab its center and vibrate the name.
steps.describe: A second blue pentagram burns to the South.

steps.title: Carry the line to the West
steps.text: Keep your arm extended. The line of fire follows you.

steps.title: Eheieh
steps.text: Trace the banishing pentagram of Earth in the West. Stab its center and vibrate the name.
steps.describe: A third blue pentagram burns to the West.

steps.title: Carry the line to the North
steps.text: Keep your arm extended. The line of fire follows you.

steps.title: AGLA
steps.text: Trace the banishing pentagram of Earth in the North. Stab its center and vibrate the name.
steps.describe: A fourth blue pentagram burns to the North.

steps.title: Close the circle in the East
steps.text: Complete the ring of white fire where you began.

steps.title: Before me, Raphael
steps.text: Robes of yellow and violet billow in a breath of air.
steps.describe: A towering winged figure in yellow and violet rises in the East, holding a wand.

steps.title: Behind me, Gabriel
steps.text: Robes of blue and orange, bearing the cup of the waters.
steps.describe: Behind you in the West rises a figure in blue and orange, holding a cup.

steps.title: On my right hand, Michael
steps.text: Robes of scarlet and emerald, bearing the sword of fire.
steps.describe: To your right in the South rises a figure in scarlet and emerald, holding a sword.

steps.title: On my left hand, Auriel
steps.text: Robes of citrine, olive and russet, bearing the fruits of the earth.
steps.describe: To your left in the North rises a figure in citrine, olive and russet, holding a sheaf of grain.

steps.title: About me flame the pentagrams
steps.text: Four blue stars burn at the quarters of the circle.
steps.describe: All four pentagrams flare brighter in turn, and the circle on the ground brightens.

steps.title: And in the column shines the six-rayed star
steps.say: And in the column shines the six-rayed star.
steps.text: A golden hexagram turns about your heart, and the column brightens.
steps.describe: A golden six-pointed star forms around you at chest height and slowly turns.

steps.title: The rite is complete
steps.text: The circle is clear. Linger as long as you like, then finish when you are ready.
